leadText:
Cremini Town (Japanese: シキミタウン Shikimi Town) is an -exclusive location found in Kanto. It appeared in Three Jynx and a Baby!. The , led by Anabel, can be found just outside of the town.

 and visited Cremini Town in Three Jynx and a Baby!. saw a and was about to hold her until the group discovered that Smoochum was being protected by a trio of overprotective . While the group decided to leave Smoochum and the Jynx alone, made plans to steal Smoochum. Ash's group was able to save Smoochum and gain the three Jynx's trust. The Smoochum subsequently evolved and became a fourth Jynx. Ash and his friends made plans to rest at Cremini Town until the next day, when they headed to the Battle Tower.
